in_marathi.name: Keerthana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Keerthana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Keerthana', which means 'the one who is recited', 'repeated', or 'praised'. It is a name that evokes the grace and blessings of the gods.
